segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the email on the account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, hi, this is Jordan at Northline Packaging. Email is jordan.reed@northlinepkg.com. I just need to add three seats to our account for new operations coordinators.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I have Northline Packaging pulled up in the admin console. You’re currently on the Team plan with 42 active seats, billing monthly on the 18th. Do you want the three new seats available today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, today if possible. Names are Priya Shah, Evan Miller, and Carlos Nguyen. They’ll all use the standard user role.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Perfect. I’m adding three standard seats now. Just to confirm, the prorated charge for the remainder of this billing period is $96.75, and then your monthly total will increase by $225 starting August 18.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s fine. Same card on file and same billing contact, please.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Done. The account now shows 45 seats, and I sent invites to priya.shah@northlinepkg.com, evan.miller@northlinepkg.com, and carlos.nguyen@northlinepkg.com. You’ll also get the receipt from the billing tool in a couple minutes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, I see one of the invites already. That covers it, thanks.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You’re welcome. I’ll note the update on ticket 48291 and close it out. Have a good one.
